title: Classic Curvy Pipes
description: Brings back the curvy pipe textures that we love... (no offence to new textures tho sksksk)
body:
## Classic Curvy Pipes!
![Classic Pipes ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16271349abbea23b5deab489d6eeef29e692eab5.png)
Could go for a rant, but it brings back the old textures from curvy pipes. Some people like it other people don't; it just boils down to preference. That's it!

If you couldn't figure it out, you need [curvy pipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/curvy-pipes) for this to work.
